name: Sunday Times cryptic crossword, book 1 No 29

clue.text: In the hands of destiny, I have prohibited force, to secure entry
Rain blows on a sailor one hears
Nut and date concoction which is sneered at
Land of Hope
Most heirs, lacking the green stuff, claim it belongs to them
In touch with a group conferring in Africa
Disreputable female editing instructions about part of the anatomy
Private English escort I fancy
Nimble when it comes to road work-out
A tear for Her Majesty — not as young as she was
Dancing bears take regular respites for refreshment
Finally dispose of relative in a Greek island
Manage meeting before eleven
Manchester City’s substitute — topping!
Covered run with side turning
Just can make it to be equal
Start of play — a triangle, time consuming
Withdraws sappers around the area
Put off giving a key to a relative
Anass in North Belgian city
Senior senators sorting out needless matter
Minor damage to hydrant — could be Panam solves the mystery
Is not worn out, though has inferior durability
Application for injury benefit
Lyrical arrangement for one harp
Instrument of uprising of a revolutionary army company
Clap wildly at current headgear for a man
Right, every one — hands up!
